luamade.script:
local function check(c, m) if not c then print("FAIL " .. m) error(m) end end
local p = console.getBlock().getPos()
local function at(dx, dy, dz) return vec3i(p.getX() + dx, p.getY() + dy, p.getZ() + dz) end

local wrapped = peripheral.wrapAt(at(1, 0, 0), "inventory")
check(wrapped ~= nil and wrapped.hasItems(), "wrap inventory")
check(wrapped.getInventoryVolume() > 0, "inventory volume")
local a = peripheral.getAt(at(1, 0, 0)).getInventory()
local b = peripheral.getAt(at(3, 0, 0)).getInventory()
check(a ~= nil and b ~= nil, "getInventory")
check(b.isEmpty() and b.hasFreeSlot() and not b.isFull(), "empty target")

local stacks = a.getItems()
check(#stacks == 1 and stacks[1].getCount() == 50, "getItems")
check(stacks[1].getInfo().getName() ~= nil, "stack info")
local id = stacks[1].getId()
check(a.getItemCount(id) == 50 and a.getTotalItemCount() == 50, "counts")

local slot = stacks[1].getSlot()
check(a.setSlotData(slot, json.encode({name = "wt"})), "setSlotData")
check(json.decode(a.getSlotData(slot)).name == "wt", "getSlotData")
a.setSlotData(slot, "{}")

check(a.transferTo(b, stacks), "transferTo")
check(a.isEmpty() and b.getItemCount(id) == 50, "after transfer")
check(not a.transferTo(b, stacks), "transfer with nothing left refused")
check(b.addItems(b.getItems()) and b.getItemCount(id) == 100, "addItems")
check(b.removeItems(stacks) and b.getItemCount(id) == 50, "removeItems")
check(not b.removeItems({stacks[1], stacks[1]}) and b.getItemCount(id) == 50, "duplicate stacks need the combined count")
check(not b.transferTo(a, {stacks[1], stacks[1]}) and a.isEmpty() and b.getItemCount(id) == 50, "transfer needs the combined count")
check(a.clearItems() and a.isEmpty(), "clearItems")
print("PASS inventory")
